description: Reserved - Department of Fiscal Policy - Export of undernatured, portable and bottled liquor meant for sales
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of a legal/regulatory instrument - specifically an Excise Notification (No. 10/2019) that establishes new regulations for the export of undenatured, potable and bottled liquor. It contains detailed regulatory requirements, procedures for export permits, duty payment conditions, documentation requirements, and rescinds a previous notification. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa, it does so only in the context of his authority to make the order under the Excise Ordinance, without detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes, making it a regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural gazette.
